active_params_definition: Backbone per-token compute parameters: all attention (including the delta v1.5 Mla indexer and the SWA branch, whose dedicated MLA K/V projections are per-token compute; the KDA window adds no matrix parameters because it shares the delta-rule q/k/v) + dense layer-0 MLP + per LatentMoE layer (latent projections, router, top-2 routed experts, all shared experts) + norms and AttnRes. Excludes the tied embedding (a lookup, not per-token compute), the ViT (active on image tokens only) and the MTP auxiliary head (training-only, dropped at inference).
deviations: This file is the dense-reference derivation of net/config.json for the verification leg (docs/specs/VERIFICATION-LEG.ru.md): the same skeleton scaled to GPT-2-class width — 12 layers x 12 heads x d_model 768 (head_dim 64, kda_dk = kda_dv = 64, mla_head_dim = 64), mlp_intermediate 3072 = 4 x 768 — with attn_dense_reference = true selecting the existing dense attention oracle (net/mla.py: _dense_apply; net/kda.py: the SWA window branch is disabled). Only values were changed, no structure and no net/*.py code: the schema invariants (num_heads * head_dim == hidden, kda_dk == kda_dv == head_dim, mla_head_dim == head_dim, num_kda_layers + num_mla_layers == num_layers, num_layers % 4 == 0) hold, verified by net.config.validate_config. Layer modes are trimmed to the 3 MLA layers actually present (['full', 'reindex', 'reindex'], ADR-012 layout preserved).

attn_dense_reference = true selects the dense *attention oracle* (dense MLA instead of the sparse+window path, and no KDA window branch); it does NOT turn the backbone into a pure GPT-2 transformer. The 9 KDA layers remain delta-rule recurrent layers and the 3 MLA layers remain gated-MLA with its latent projection, and the Stable LatentMoE channel mixing stays (1 dense + 11 LatentMoE layer-mixing). A pure GPT-2-class dense backbone would require a new layer type in net/model.py, which the task forbids; this is escalated as an open question, not worked around.

actual_param_count = 353,971,849 and active_params_per_token = 100,483,068 are measured for THIS config with net.model.param_count / active_param_count (shape-only, jax.eval_shape). The total exceeds classical GPT-2 124M (50K vocab) for two declared reasons: the 160K tokenizer vocabulary (embedding 160000 x 768 = 122.9M vs GPT-2's 38.4M) and the skeleton's extra machinery (KDA/MLA projections, AttnRes over all layers, LatentMoE experts, ViT, MTP). The comparison with GPT-2 124M is therefore by BPB, not by parameter count (VERIFICATION-LEG.ru.md, 'Метрика и эталон').
